composio.note: Todoist is Composio-managed OAuth. Todoist MCP is a separate toolkit (TODOIST_MCP) that needs your own OAuth app.

need_own_app.answer: Not to start: Composio's managed app works for prototypes. Use your own app for launch if users should see your brand, you want dedicated quota, or you need scopes beyond Composio's defaults.
reasons: Consent screen shows 'Composio wants to access your account' with the managed app
Managed apps share quota across all Composio users
Managed auth enforces a 15-minute minimum trigger polling interval
Composio's default scopes may not cover what you need
Your brand on the provider consent screen

scenarios.label: Public agent using your own Todoist app
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent connects many outside users' Todoist accounts through your own OAuth app registered in Todoist.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No provider review is required to share an integration with users (c1).

scenarios.approval: No review is required to develop and share with users. Marketplace certification is optional and mainly adds visibility. Whether scopes or user numbers are limited was not found.

prerequisites.title: Todoist account
prerequisites.detail: You need to sign in to a Todoist account to open the App Management console.

steps.title: Create the Todoist app
steps.detail: Sign in, open Settings > Integrations > App Management, and create the app.
steps.done_when: App exists and shows a Client ID and Client secret.

steps.title: Copy redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: Get the callback URL from the Composio dashboard for the Todoist auth config, ready to paste into the app.
steps.done_when: You have the exact redirect URI.

steps.title: Register redirect URI in Todoist
steps.detail: Enter the Composio redirect URI in the app's OAuth redirect URL field. Several can be added.
steps.done_when: Redirect URL is saved on the app.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Todoist auth config via Composio's API with your own client ID and secret. Choose the scopes your agent needs.

steps.title: Test a connection
steps.detail: Connect a test Todoist account and confirm the consent screen shows your app.
steps.done_when: Connected account is active and a tool call succeeds.

traps.title: Token refresh is one-way on older apps
traps.detail: Short-lived tokens last 1 hour and need a refresh token. Enabling refresh on an older app cannot be reversed, and tokens issued earlier stay long-lived.

traps.title: Managed app hides your brand
traps.detail: With Composio's managed app, users see 'Composio wants to access your account'. Quota is shared, and trigger polling is at least every 15 minutes.

traps.title: Scopes are set at authorization
traps.detail: Scopes are requested when each account authorizes the app, not on the app itself.

traps.title: Todoist MCP is a different toolkit
traps.detail: The TODOIST_MCP toolkit is bring-your-own-app, unlike the managed TODOIST toolkit.

blockers.what_it_means: Too many client registrations were made in a short period through dynamic registration.
blockers.what_to_do: Wait and retry later, or create the app in the console.
